This file fits the pre-registered LBA model for Exp 4 in the face familiarity study.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

pkgs <- c(
  "EMC2", "tidyverse", "here"
  )
vapply(
  pkgs, library, logical(1), character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE
  )
```

# 1. Read in data and wrangle

```{r}
#| label: read-data

raw <- read_csv(here("exp_4", "data", "data_exp_4.csv"))
```

```{r}
#| label: wrangle

data_emc <- raw |>
  select(pid, cond, keypress, rt) |>
  rename(subjects = pid, S = cond, R = keypress) |>
  mutate(
    subjects = factor(subjects),
    S        = factor(S, levels = c("Novel", "Famous")),
    R        = if_else(R == "q", "Famous", "Novel"),
    R        = factor(R, levels = c("Novel", "Famous"))
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()
```

# 2. Preregistered model

## 2.1 Build model

```{r}
#| label: matchfun

matchfun <- function(d) d$S == d$lR
```

```{r}
#| label: design

design_exp4_v1 <- design(
  data      = data_emc,
  model     = LBA,
  matchfun  = matchfun,
  formula   = list(v ~ 0 + S:lM, sv ~ 0 + lM, B ~ 0 + lR, A ~ 1, t0 ~ 1),
  constants = c(sv_lMFALSE = log(1))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: p-vector

p_vector <- c(
  "v_SNovel:lMFALSE"  = 4, "v_SFamous:lMFALSE" = 4,
  "v_SNovel:lMTRUE"   = 4, "v_SFamous:lMTRUE"  = 4,
  sv_lMTRUE           = log(.5),
  B_lRNovel           = log(2), B_lRFamous = log(2),
  A                   = log(.5), t0 = log(.3)
)

mapped_pars(p_vector, x = design_exp4_v1)
```

```{r}
#| label: priors

mu_mean <- c(
  "v_SNovel:lMFALSE"  = 0, "v_SFamous:lMFALSE" = 0,
  "v_SNovel:lMTRUE"   = 1, "v_SFamous:lMTRUE"  = 1,
  sv_lMTRUE           = log(.5),
  B_lRNovel           = log(1), B_lRFamous = log(1),
  A                   = log(.5), t0 = log(.3)
)

mu_sd <- c(
  "v_SNovel:lMFALSE"  = 2, "v_SFamous:lMFALSE" = 2,
  "v_SNovel:lMTRUE"   = 2, "v_SFamous:lMTRUE"  = 2,
  sv_lMTRUE           = .5,
  B_lRNovel           = .5, B_lRFamous = .5,
  A                   = .3, t0 = .3
)

prior_exp4_v1 <- prior(design_exp4_v1, type = "standard",
                       mu_mean = mu_mean, mu_sd = mu_sd)
plot(x = prior_exp4_v1)
```

## 2.2 Fit model

```{r}
#| label: fit
#| eval: false

LBA_exp4_v1 <- make_emc(data_emc, design_exp4_v1,
                         type = "standard", prior = prior_exp4_v1)
LBA_exp4_v1 <- fit(LBA_exp4_v1,
  cores_per_chain  = 2,
  cores_for_chains = 3,
  fileName         = here("exp_4", "models", "tmp.RData"),
  iter             = 10000,
  step_size        = 500
)
save(LBA_exp4_v1, file = here("exp_4", "models", "LBA_exp4_v1.RData"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load

load(here("exp_4", "models", "LBA_exp4_v1.RData"))
```

## 2.3 Check model

```{r}
#| label: check

check(LBA_exp4_v1)
get_pars(LBA_exp4_v1, map = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-pars

plot_pars(LBA_exp4_v1, selection = "mu", layout = c(2, 5))
```

## 2.4 Posterior predictions

```{r}
#| label: posterior-predictions
#| eval: false

pp_LBA_exp4_v1 <- predict(LBA_exp4_v1, n_cores = 10)
save(pp_LBA_exp4_v1, file = here("exp_4", "models", "pp_LBA_exp4_v1.RData"))
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-fit

load(here("exp_4", "models", "pp_LBA_exp4_v1.RData"))
plot_fit(data_emc, pp_LBA_exp4_v1, factors = c("S"), layout = c(2, 3))
```
